# GymCrush

> GymCrush is an iOS fitness app for couples with shared daily challenges, one shared streak, and workout photos for each other.

Status: Coming soon; not yet live on the App Store. Platform: iOS. Language: US English. Official website: https://getgymcrush.com/.

## Verified product features

- Both partners get the same daily challenges and share one streak.
- Partner pushes report completed workouts, moments, dares, dare outcomes, and chosen stakes.
- Team Assist merges both partners’ daily goals into one bar; a streak freeze is available.
- Stakes are bets on the shared streak. Partners can send dares and moments (workout photos).
- A lock-screen widget shows the partner’s photo.
- Couples hatch mascots from Mascot Balls and have a 90-day reward path.
- Annual subscription with a 3-day trial; no price is stated here.

These guides contain original planning suggestions, separate from the app’s features. No weight-loss results, body outcomes, user counts, ratings, or customer testimonials are claimed.
